photographs.line: The only thing I'll keep are the letters and the photographs
stanza: Traveling with some stuff I left when I was a kid
Mr. Bear and the wooden box I hid
Full of broken gadgets that mean nothin' now
The only thing I'll keep are the letters and the photographs

photographs.line: In Penny Lane, there is a barber showing photographs
stanza: In Penny Lane, there is a barber showing photographs
Of every head he's had the pleasure to have known
And all the people that come and go
